newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar opens flat in light trading.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar opens flat in light trading.

text.p: * Canada's dollar opened flat in light trading at C$1.3963 (US$0.7161) on Wednesday after a quiet overnight session on overseas markets, traders said.* They said they expected the currency to trade within a narrow range of C$1.3940 (US$0.7173) and C$1.3980 (US$0.7153) today as investors continue to speculate about possible U.S. interest rate hikes.
Canada's dollar opened flat in light trading at C$1.3963 (US$0.7161) on Wednesday after a quiet overnight session on overseas markets, traders said.
They said they expected the currency to trade within a narrow range of C$1.3940 (US$0.7173) and C$1.3980 (US$0.7153) today as investors continue to speculate about possible U.S. interest rate hikes.
Speculation that a U.S. rate hike was imminent in May eased on Tuesday after the U.S. government reported a 0.1 percent rise in the March consumer price index, compared to forecasts of 0.2 percent.
The Canadian dollar appears to have stabilised at relatively weak levels with markets fully pricing in the last rate hike, one trader said.
The U.S. Federal Reserve raised interest rates by 25 basis points on March 25, sparking a surge in the strength of the U.S. dollar and placing downward pressure on the Canadian currency.
Analysts said the U.S. interest rate speculation continued to fuel a strong overseas interest to buy U.S. dollars at the expense of weaker currencies such as the Canada dollar and German mark.

"The Canada (dollar) was very much sidelined overnight," said Stephen Wateridge, managing director of corporate foreign exchange with CIBC Wood Gundy. "There is still talk of (central bank) intervention, which helps to take the shine off the dollar."
The Bank of Canada has intervened three times since last Thursday to support the weakening Canadian currency.
On the crosses, the Canada dollar rose to 1.2348 marks from Tuesday's close of 1.2309 marks and fell to 90.01 yen from Tuesday's 90.19 yen.
